 People Are Heartbroken For Robin Williams’s Daughter, Zelda Williams, After She Revealed She Is Being Relentlessly Harassed By “Conspiracy Theorists” Who Are Convinced She Helped Him Fake His Death
 “Man, the amount of grief she has had to endure from people about her dad is insane.”
 Posted on Oct 29, 2026 UTC comment 
 Facebook 
 Pinterest 
 Link 
 by Stephanie Soteriou BuzzFeed BuzzFeed Staff I’m an innately nosey and chronically online celebrity and pop culture journalist, with my specialist areas including deep-diving lyrics and calling out Terrible Men™.
 It has been more than 12 years since Robin Williams died in 2014 at age 63, with the screen legend one of the most beloved actors in Hollywood thanks to his starring roles in several popular films throughout his career, including Aladdin, Mrs. Doubtfire , Jumanji , and Dead Poets Society . 
 Vera Anderson / Getty Images
 And in recent years, Robin’s daughter, Zelda Williams, has been incredibly vocal about her concern over how people use AI on celebrities — revealing in 2023 that people had already used artificial intelligence to replicate her late dad’s voice. 
 Matthew Peyton / Getty Images
 For what it’s worth, this is particularly problematic as Robin was famously very protective of the use of his voice work in life, and even feuded with Disney after they used his character in Aladdin , the Genie, to sell merchandise. The feud was so dramatic that Robin did not return for the animated movie’s sequel, and Homer Simpson voice actor, Dan Castellaneta, was cast to replace him as the Genie instead. Robin did return for the third movie, Aladdin and the King of Thieves , two years later. 
 TV Guide / Courtesy Everett Collection
 Writing on her Instagram story off the back of the SAG-AFTRA strike at the time, Zelda said: “I am not an impartial voice in the SAG’s fight against AI. I’ve witnessed for YEARS how many people want to train these models to create/recreate actors who cannot consent, like Dad. This isn’t theoretical, it is very very real. I’ve already heard AI used to get his ‘voice’ to say whatever people want and while I find it personally disturbing, the ramifications go far beyond my own feelings.” 
 Courtesy Everett Collection
 “Living actors deserve a chance to create characters with their choices, to voice cartoons, to put their HUMAN effort and time into the pursuit of performance,” Zelda added. “These recreations are, at the very best, a poor facsimile of greater people, but at their worst, a horrendous Frankensteinian monster, cobbled together from the worst bits of everything this industry is, instead of what it should stand for,” she concluded the post. 
 Zelda Williams / Via Instagram: @zeldawilliams 
 Fast-forward three years, and Zelda has revealed that she is now being harassed by conspiracy theorists who are convinced that she helped Robin fake his own death and that he is secretly still alive, in part due to AI technology. 
 Miikka Skaffari / Getty Images
 Taking to her Instagram story, Zelda drew attention to the popular Instagram account @ unc.pappy , aka Uncle Pappy, real name Blair Carlyle, who has more than 1 million followers thanks to his uncanny online impersonations. Uncle Pappy uses AI to change his physical appearance in his videos, and is known for his voice impression of Robin. 
 Uncle Pappy / Via tiktok.com 
 On Monday, Zelda shared a screenshot of a comment she was tagged in that read: “@zeldawilliams lmfao you’re daddy’s still alive and you know that cuz you’re a sell out demon too you vampires never die. His name is @unc.pappy now,” and she added alongside it: “You think the guy who has openly admitted on his page he’s using an old age filter is my Dad? That guy? No shade to Unc Pappy, he seems like an upbeat dude who does impressions, but as for you aggressively wrong dumbass, AI is going to absolutely destroy your grasp on reality.” 
 Zelda Williams / Via Instagram: @zeldawilliams 
 She then shared one of Uncle Pappy’s videos where he removed the facial filter to show his true identity, writing: “This is the person multiple conspiracy theorists have sent me, usually while accusing me of being part of some vast network misleading them on my father’s death. I’m grateful to see someone actually dispelling this madness as opposed to feeding it.” 
 Zelda Williams / Uncle Pappy / Via Instagram: @zeldawilliams 
 “It’s not his fault his impression while in a filter somehow created a ridiculous rumor, nor is it his fault people will wind themselves into knots to believe insane things,” Zelda then noted. “But I do hope more people are coming to terms with the fact that any technology that can obscure reality or truth, especially in an ‘entertaining’ way, will create enormous issues for trust and even sanity in society in general.” 
 Zelda Williams / Via Instagram: @zeldawilliams 
 She concluded with a photo of her pet dog as she called out people on the internet who “keep trying to cast me or my family in their insane personal conspiracy soap operas.” 
 Zelda Williams / Via Instagram: @zeldawilliams 
 Needless to say, this whole situation has horrified other social media users, with many expressing their deepest sympathy over how difficult it must be for Zelda to have her late dad repeatedly brought up in this way. One Reddit comment reacting to her Instagram posts reads : “Man, the amount of grief she has had to endure from people about her dad is insane.” 
 Kevin Winter / Getty Images
 “these people are so disgusting for harassing her,” somebody else wrote . Another added : “Having a super famous parent is probably exhausting enough on it's own. But a deceased super famous parent has got to be 100 times worse. Crazies always trying to convince you your dad ran off with Tupac.” 
 L. Cohen / Getty Images
 One more shared : “this is like the fourth time shes had to call people out like leave her alone, this must be so awful for her.” While somebody else wrote : “Oh my god. What the actual fuck? Now we have AI psychosis. I wish people would just let him rest in peace, his kids should not be dealing with this shit.” 
 Gregg DeGuire / Getty Images
 Another wrote : “It was already hard enough to deal with conspiracy theorists before AI, now with AI it’s going to be an absolute fucking shitshow. I feel for anyone who is forced to deal with them directly.” One more comment reads : “Can you IMAGINE losing a parent in such a devastating way, and then having people harass you about said death and accuse you of lying, and you have to constantly assure people your dead parent who died tragically is, in fact, dead?These people are the scum of the EARTH. God I feel so bad for her.” 
 Michael Buckner / Getty Images
 Our thoughts are with Zelda at this seriously unpleasant time — as always, let me know your thoughts in the comments below.
